verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents a broad HTTP/SDK API: feedback posts, help-center article editing (including an AI-agent-oriented find/replace endpoint), training data for its support AI, and a Reports API that 'exposes the same analytics engine that powers the Reports section of the dashboard.' That last item is explicit UI parity, but only for reports. Webhooks and an llms.txt add to the openness picture. There is no stated commitment to full UI/API parity, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the standard probed paths. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity guarantee across all UI features, evidenced API coverage for changelog/roadmap/inbox/conversations/settings/integrations, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
